entities.summary: Juan de Santa Cruz Pachacuti Yamqui Salcamayhua was an indigenous Peruvian chronicler, author of the work Spanish: Relación de las antigüedades deste Reyno del Perú, lit. 'List of the antiquities of this Kingdom of Peru', of brief length but great worth for the ethnohistorical studies.
